scripts.dev: node -e "if(process.env.RENDER) { require('child_process').execSync('python3 -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ' + process.env.PORT, {stdio: 'inherit'}); } else { require('child_process').execSync('concurrently -k \"npm run dev:server\" \"npm run dev:web\"', {stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
scripts.build: (python3 -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt --break-system-packages || pip install -r backend/requirements.txt --break-system-packages || pip3 install -r backend/requirements.txt --break-system-packages) && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.start: python3 -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3001} || python -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3001}
